description: This file is a shell script used for testing various complex scenarios involving Git merge conflicts, including renames, additions, deletions, binary files, submodules, directories, and conflict detection logic. It defines multiple setup functions to create specific repository states and corresponding tests to verify Git's behavior in these situations.

methods.name: test_setup_rename_delete_untracked
methods.description: Sets up a repository with a renaming and deletion scenario involving untracked files.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success after executing a shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects a command to fail.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a file.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a given output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or outputs for equality.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in output and verifies its presence.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Verifies if a given path is missing.

methods.name: test_seq
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers or lines for testing.

methods.name: test_hash_object
methods.description: Calculates hash for given objects or data to verify content integrity.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the Git timestamp to simulate different commit times.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a command's output or a file is empty.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Runs a command and expects a specific exit code.
